facts.fact: Anganwadi Services give six services: supplementary nutrition, pre-school education, nutrition and health education, immunization, health check-up and referral services
facts.quote: Six key services are offered, including Supplementary Nutrition, Pre-school Education, Nutrition & Health Education, Immunization, Health Check-up, and Referral Services.

facts.fact: Pregnant women, lactating mothers and children aged 6 months to 3 years (and SAM children) are entitled to Take-Home Ration
facts.quote: All pregnant women and lactating mothers (PW&LM), children in the age group of 6-36 months, SAM children and adolescent girls in the age group of 14-18 years (wherever applicable) are entitled to receive THR

facts.fact: Children aged 3 to 6 years get a hot cooked meal and morning snacks at the Anganwadi centre
facts.quote: Children in the age group of 3-6 years are entitled to receive HCM and Morning Snacks under the Anganwadi Services from the AWC where they are registered.

facts.fact: Early childhood care and education (pre-school) is for children aged 3 to 6 years, with early stimulation for 0 to 3 years
facts.quote: Early Childhood Care and Education (3-6 years) and early stimulation for (0-3 years)

behaviour: Lists the Anganwadi services for children and for pregnant and lactating women as published by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, citing wcd.gov.in; replies in Hindi.
fail_if: Invents services or entitlements not listed by WCD, or gives no official citation.
summary: Added WCD's six Anganwadi services and who gets Take-Home Ration (pregnant/lactating women, children 6-36 months) vs hot cooked meal (3-6 years), from the WCD Poshan 2.0 page and scheme guidelines.
